top_signals.title: India Plans to Retain More Short-Term Military Recruits
top_signals.summary: India overhauled a short-term military recruitment plan by extending conscripts’ tenure and offering a path to permanent employment as border tensions with China and Pakistan continue to pressure the country’s defense establishment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China expands overseas mining stakes, tightening grip on critical minerals
top_signals.summary: Beijing is building a system of agencies and state-backed vehicles to own more of the metals it depends on, while keeping its edge in processing skills.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Uber beats on revenue even as mobility and delivery units miss estimates
top_signals.summary: Uber reported better-than-expected revenue but its mobility unit faced higher fuel costs overseas and tighter driver supply.
